summary: WEB-ONLY frontend verification of iteration 107 (Option B mobile inline AI comparison + slim dismissible EmployeeCrossSell banner + mobile chat header declutter). Tested at mobile 390x844 (buildertest free-plan and amit super-admin) and desktop 1440x900 (amit). All five acceptance criteria PASS: (1) desktop opens the docked side-by-side ai-comparison panel with vote/synthesize/share/copy-synthesis/select-best all functional; (2) mobile renders ai-comparison-inline in the chat feed and ai-comparison is absent; (3) all documented inline testids exist and work (vote, select-best, task, save, copy/share/task-synthesis, close-comparison-inline); (4) mobile chat header hides smart-hire-pill + chat-devos-spin-up-pill + chat-devos-quick-open (visible=false via hidden md:flex) and shows the single Project pill; (5) EmployeeCrossSell banner appears top-right under the credits pill on /chats list and /dashboard for the free-plan user, is absent on any /chats/<id> route, and is absent for the unlimited super-admin (amit). Share flow surfaces a public URL toast successfully.

issues: Pre-existing 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay from a 404 XHR (AxiosError) on the dashboard route — unrelated to the two UX changes under test, but still visible over the page. Cross-sell banner still shows correctly above it.

action_items: (Optional) Fix the pre-existing 404 that surfaces the red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay on /dashboard — not caused by iteration 107 but visible while validating the cross-sell banner.
critical_code_review_comments: AIComparisonInline.jsx pitch.link fallback: EmployeeCrossSell.jsx nav(pitch.link || '/employees') references pitch.link but EMPLOYEE_PITCHES entries never set a link property, so it always falls back to /employees. Either drop the || short-circuit or add per-employee deep links (e.g., /employees/paralegal).

isMobile breakpoint in Chats.jsx (640px, sm) is one step below Tailwind's md (768px) that ChatHeader uses to gate the Dev OS / SmartHire pills. Between 640 and 767px the comparison already uses the desktop docked panel but the header still hides the pills. Consider aligning both to the same breakpoint (either 640 or 768) so behavior is consistent in the 640–767 tablet gap.
Chats.jsx#651 window.innerWidth read is fine but the listener is 'resize'-only; add 'orientationchange' or use matchMedia for robustness on iOS Safari where a resize is not always fired on rotation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (13/13 targeted checks passed across mobile + desktop)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The mobile threshold in Chats.jsx is <640px, the header-pill declutter threshold in ChatHeader.jsx is <768px (md). If retesting header pills, use 390px viewport (mobile) and >=768 (desktop). The 'Show all comparisons' link only appears AFTER the AI answer bubble is rendered under the '@ai compare' user message — typically 2–20s. On the buildertest workspace there are currently no seeded chats, so use /dashboard or /chats (list) or a synthetic /chats/fake-id path to exercise the cross-sell banner gating (already covered here).
rca of the issue: No bugs — verification only. Everything requested in the review works end-to-end.
